EDGE BOARD —

What the columns mean
Win is the share of trades that made money. It is not the same as being profitable. Expectancy is average profit per trade in units of the risk taken — this is the one that decides whether you make money. PF, profit factor, is gross profit divided by gross loss. Below 1.0 the rule loses. Score /100 combines expectancy, profit factor, whether the edge survived after mid-2023, and sample size.

What the testing found

None of this is a trade. It is the evidence behind the verdicts on the Strategies tab, and the results worth knowing even though nothing here is actionable — including the things that did not work.

Not investment advice. These are historical statistics on mechanical rule sets, not predictions. Past distributions do not bind future ones. Every number here is reproducible from the scripts in this project — nothing is estimated or recalled.
